text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince listens on Saturday to the reply of the two houses of parliament on the throne's speech.
- Jordan and European Union (EU) accord to be signed by the end of the year.
- Total deposits of banking system stand at 5.94 billion dinars ($8.38 billion) in the nine months of 1996, an increase of 154.7 million dinars since the start of the year.
- Cabinet examines on Saturday the lists of pardoned detainees.
- Justice Minister says 300 detainees expected to be released at end of the week.
- Crown Prince Hassan opens the Arab-European Parliamentary dialogue conference on Saturday.
- Forwarding companies call for easing red tape in customs measures.
- Islamist deputy meets the management of Jordan Electric Power in talks over resolving labour dispute with workers.
- Egyptian ambassador to Jordan says Egypt studying accepting Jordanian students in Egyptian medical schools.
- Jordan reaffirms solidarity with the Palestinians, "pledges continued support for their struggle."
